net_projection_charge_identity.name: R5_E8_NET_PROJECTION_CHARGE_IDENTITY_V1

definitions.N: number of old reachable nodes in current state S
definitions.A_v: number of reachable AND gates whose transitive fanin contains unresolved variable v
definitions.kappa_v: number of old v-independent reachable nodes absent from Q_v
definitions.NEW_v: reachable node ids of Q_v not present in the old reachable set

net_projection_charge_identity.bounded_new_nodes: |NEW_v| <= 2*A_v+1 because each cofactor can allocate at most one new AND per old v-dependent AND gate, plus at most one final OR node
proof: All old v-dependent AND nodes disappear after restriction because returned cofactor DAGs are v-free.
The old input node v disappears.
Exactly kappa_v additional old v-independent nodes disappear by definition.
net_projection_charge_identity.selector_key_equivalence: Within one current state N is common, so frozen key (cost,A_v,id) is equivalent to (E_v,A_v,id).

family.formula: AND_i ((x_i OR z_i OR NOT z_{i+1}) AND (NOT x_i OR z_{i+2} OR NOT z_{i+3})) with payload indices cyclic mod m

live_size_derivation: 4m clause-AIG gates because each of 2m three-literal clauses contributes two gates

derivation: Each selector occurs in two clauses and contributes four dependent clause gates total.
The complete block tree contributes r dependent ancestors above G_i.
Each cofactor constructs one two-literal payload clause node plus r rebuilt tree ancestors.
The final Shannon OR contributes one new node.
No x-independent internal gate in the affected clause trees is lost because the selector literal is the first literal in each clause and all unaffected siblings remain reachable.

payload_profile.s_j: number of the four occurrences where z_j is the first payload literal after the selector in frozen literal order
payload_profile.T_j: number of dependent upper block-tree AND gates in the rooted union of the four support-block paths
payload_profile.key_cancellation: The local clause-order term s_j cancels exactly from E_z.
derivation: The four affected clauses contribute 4+s_j dependent clause gates.
The four G blocks contribute four dependent gates.
The rooted block-tree union contributes T_j dependent gates.
Across both cofactors, the s_j first-payload occurrences create s_j residual two-literal clause nodes in total.
Exactly two affected z-literals are unsatisfied in each cofactor, creating exactly two modified G nodes per cofactor, four total.
Each cofactor rebuilds exactly the T_j affected upper block-tree gates.
The final Shannon OR contributes one node.
Every old z-independent node remains reachable in at least one cofactor: satisfied-clause residual structure is exposed by the opposite cofactor and unaffected sibling subtrees remain reachable.

rooted_support_bound.proof: Four distinct support leaves in a complete height-r binary block tree require at least three internal nodes to join the four leaves plus r-2 ancestors from the four-leaf subtree root to the global root; equality occurs for an aligned four-leaf subtree.

comparison: Every payload has E_z=T_j-4 >= r-3 = E_x.
If E_z=E_x then T_j=r+1 and A_z=T_j+s_j+8 >= r+9 > r+5=A_x.
Thus every selector beats every payload at step 0 under the exact frozen lexicographic key.
All selectors tie in E and A initially, so the variable-id tie-break chooses x1.
initial_state.conclusion: For every m=2^r>=4, the first frozen greedy choice is x1.

additional_scope_checks.m8: all odd-prefix permutation states checked diagnostically: no violation of related payload domination or payload kappa=0 / sigma<=s+12 bounds
additional_scope_checks.m16: random odd-prefix states checked diagnostically: no violation observed

sharpened_open_core.name: R5_E8_ODD_PREFIX_NET_CHARGE_THEOREM_V1
sharpened_open_core.target: For every odd-only prefix state before all odd selectors are removed, there exists an unresolved odd selector o such that for every payload z the tuple (E_o,A_o,o) is lexicographically smaller than (E_z,A_z,z).
useful_reduction: Payload kappa_z=0 is sufficient; odd-selector kappa_o need not be zero because positive kappa_o only helps the selector.
A sufficient local inequality when kappa_z=0 is A_z-A_o >= sigma_z-sigma_o; equality in E is then resolved by A_o<A_z or finally by selector id.
The amplifier theorem remains closed and must not be reopened.

payload_backbone_subgate.name: R5_E8_PAYLOAD_BACKBONE_RIGIDITY_V1
target: prove kappa_z=0 for every payload on every odd-only prefix state
prove sigma_z<=s_z+12, where s_z is the frozen local clause-order count from the original four payload occurrences
interpretation: all extra Shannon-backbone dependent gates must rebuild without additional semantic/structural collapse; payload savings remain local

related_cone_subgate.name: R5_E8_RELATED_PAYLOAD_CONE_GAP_V1
related_cone_subgate.target: If payload z still has an unresolved odd selector o in one of its four support blocks, prove A_z-A_o >= s_z+4.
related_cone_subgate.consequence: Together with sigma_o>=8 and payload rigidity, E_z-E_o >= 0; since A_z>A_o, the related odd selector strictly beats z under the frozen key.

orphan_payload_subgate.name: R5_E8_ORPHAN_PAYLOAD_BARRIER_V1
orphan_payload_subgate.definition: payload whose two odd support selectors have already been projected
orphan_payload_subgate.target: show no orphan payload can become the minimum payload key before all odd selectors are removed, or exhibit the first symbolic counterexample

odd_selector_savings_floor.claim: In any state reached by projecting only other odd selectors, every still-unresolved odd selector o satisfies sigma_o >= 8.
proof: The original unprojected block G_o remains an exact shared structural sub-DAG because no previous projection touched variable o.
Its two selector clauses contribute four o-dependent clause gates and G_o contributes one o-dependent block gate.
Across the two cofactors o=0 and o=1 those five local gates create at most one residual two-literal payload-clause node per cofactor, two new local nodes total.
Thus among the ten local dependent-gate opportunities across both cofactors at least eight do not contribute a new reachable node.
Any additional simplification, interning hit, unreachable fresh node, or final-OR collapse can only increase sigma_o.
Therefore sigma_o>=8 independently of the size of the global Shannon backbone.
